description: Compares your brand with competitors. Returns each keyword with matches in the period, with matched, relevant, negative and buy-intent counts and its percentage of all brand and competitor matches. Topics are counted but not part of the split. The period works as in get_analytics_summary. compare=true adds each keyword's matches for the period just before.

compare.description: true adds the equally long period just before as `previous`.

from.description: Start date in `timezone`, as YYYY-MM-DD. That day is included.

keywordIds.description: Keeps these keyword ids only. Repeat the parameter or separate values with commas. Leave it out for all keywords.

platforms.description: Keeps these platforms only. Repeat the parameter or separate values with commas. Leave it out for all platforms.

range.description: A preset period up to today, 30d by default. Ignored when you send from or to.

timezone.description: The IANA time zone used to split days, such as America/New_York. Defaults to UTC. The zone's offset at the end of the period is used for the whole period.

to.description: End date in `timezone`, as YYYY-MM-DD, included. Defaults to today.

name: get_share_of_voice
title: Get share of voice
